title: Run on an empty choice sequence
statement: Let $N$ be an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine, let $O$ be a language over its symbol alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration for an input word. Running $N$ with oracle $O$ on the empty sequence of choice bits leaves $c$ unchanged.
